issue: Missing weeks (2019 W16; 2020 W11–18 COVID lockdown; 2020 W41–52; 2021 W1–2, W21–24, W34)
core_handling: Kept as NULL in core (provenance=missing); imputation left to modules

issue: Week 53 present in 2024 wholesale but not retail; HARTI weeks are not ISO weeks
core_handling: Week 53 averaged into week 52; core calendar uses 7-day blocks from 1 Jan (week 52 spans 8–9 days)

issue: Red pumpkin 2024/25 Maha production (9,608.4 t) identical to capsicum value; implies 2.3 t/ha vs ~11 t/ha normally
core_handling: Core uses extent × 11.0 t/ha (provenance=estimated); raw value retained

issue: Bandakka 2025 Yala equals Ash plantain 2025 Maha (32,681.1) in DCS workbook – indicates copy errors in 2025 provisional data
Values revised between AgStat editions (e.g. 2022 tomato annual extent 6,008 ha in AgStat 2023 vs 5,893 ha in AgStat 2024)
District name variants and text-extraction splits: Moneragala, Nuwaraeliya, N eliya, Mullathivu, Kurunagala, "Pol onnaruwa IP", "Hasal aka IP", "Monaragal a IP"
core_handling: Canonicalised to 25 standard district names; IP (inter-province) rows merged into their district

issue: Some bulletins are image-only (no extractable tables); several reports are partial-season progress, not finals
core_handling: District shares taken from final or latest-available reports for 5 seasons; other seasons synthetic

issue: DOA Crop Forecast winged bean extent (~650–740 ha) far below DCS 3-season averages (~960–1,130 ha) – different methodologies
Yield, cost and profit published per acre; core uses per kg / per hectare
core_handling: Unit costs (Rs/kg) carried; per-hectare values derived with 1 ha = 2.471 ac

issue: 2020/21 Maha special issue (COVID) omitted vegetables except green chilli; cucumber and winged bean never surveyed
core_handling: Interpolated (tomato, pumpkin) or synthetic (cucumber, winged bean); see provenance
Extended to 2025-12-31 by analog-year block bootstrap (provenance=synthetic)

issue: No winged bean price series published by HARTI weekly file
core_handling: Synthetic weekly series from AgStat annual farm-gate prices (provenance=synthetic)

issue: No public market-arrivals series for any economic centre
core_handling: Arrivals modelled from production, planting progress, crop calendar, loss rates and DEC share (provenance=synthetic)

issue: Only selected official monthly CCPI points available in project files
core_handling: Monthly CCPI log-interpolated between anchors (provenance=estimated); replace with official DCS series
